title: SSC Junior Engineer (JE) 2026
description: Staff Selection Commission competitive recruitment of Junior Engineers across CPWD, MES, and Central Water Commission. Requires a 3-Year Diploma in Civil, Mechanical, or Electrical Engineering from a recognized institution.
selectionProcess: Tier-I (Computer Based Test, 200 Marks) ➔ Tier-II (Descriptive Engineering Domain, 300 Marks) ➔ Document Verification.
syllabus: Paper-I: General Intelligence & Reasoning (50), General Awareness (50), Core Engineering (100). Paper-II: Detailed technical curriculum.
checklist: SBTET 3-Year Diploma Provisional / Marks Memo
SSC (10th) Board Certificate for Date of Birth verification
Valid Category Certificate (OBC-NCL / SC / ST / EWS) if applicable
Aadhaar Card / Govt Photo ID

title: RRB Assistant Loco Pilot (ALP) & Technicians
description: Ministry of Railways recruitment across various Railway Recruitment Boards (including Secunderabad). Demands strict Medical Standard A-1 with clear distance and color vision.
selectionProcess: CBT-1 (Screening) ➔ CBT-2 (Part A: Merit, Part B: Trade Qualifying) ➔ CBAT (Aptitude Test) ➔ Comprehensive Medical Exam.
syllabus: Maths, General Intelligence & Reasoning, Basic Science & Engineering, General Awareness.
checklist: SBTET Diploma or ITI Certificate in eligible trade
A-1 Medical Vision Fitness Declaration
Community & Non-Creamy Layer Certificate (issued within valid fiscal year)
Original Identity Card

title: TSGENCO Sub-Engineer (Electrical & Civil)
description: Telangana State Power Generation Corporation Limited hiring Diploma Engineers for thermal and hydro power plant maintenance across Telangana districts.
selectionProcess: Written Examination (100 Marks: 80 Core Technical + 20 General Studies & Telangana Culture) ➔ Certificate Verification.
syllabus: Core SBTET Diploma C-21/C-24 syllabus (80%) and Telangana Statehood history, general aptitude (20%).
checklist: SBTET Diploma Certificate in DEEE / DCE
Telangana Local Candidate Study / Residence Certificate (Classes 4 to 10)
Integrated Community Certificate (Caste Certificate from MeeSeva)
Non-Creamy Layer Certificate for BC candidates

title: TGPSC Assistant Engineer (AE - I&CAD, PR&RD)
description: Telangana Public Service Commission recruitment for Assistant Engineers in Irrigation and Rural Water Supply. Requires a recognized LCE/LME/LEE Diploma or equivalent.
selectionProcess: Computer-Based or OMR Written Examination ➔ Direct Document Verification.
syllabus: Paper-1: General Studies and General Abilities. Paper-2: Engineering Discipline (Diploma Level).
checklist: Diploma in Civil / Mechanical / Electrical Engineering
Telangana Zone Study Certificate (Local status proof)
EWS Certificate (Current financial year) if applicable

title: DRDO CEPTAM 11 (Technician-A & Tech Assistant)
description: Centre for Personnel Talent Management under DRDO hiring technical personnel for research laboratories across India.
selectionProcess: Tier-I (CBT screening test) ➔ Tier-II (Trade / Skill Test - qualifying nature).
syllabus: Quantitative Aptitude, Reasoning, Trade Section based on Core Curriculum.
checklist: SBTET Recognized 3-Year Diploma or ITI in relevant trade
Valid Govt ID
Caste & Domicile certificate

title: ISRO ICRB Technical Assistant
description: ISRO Centralised Recruitment Board hiring First-Class Diploma holders for satellite and launch-vehicle tracking facilities.
selectionProcess: Written Examination (80 MCQs) ➔ Practical Skill Test (Pass/Fail).
syllabus: Complete technical curriculum of respective SBTET engineering discipline.
checklist: First-Class Diploma Marks Memo with minimum 60% aggregate
No-Objection Certificate (if already employed in PSU/Govt)
